description: Header file defining the LegacyQuicStreamIdManager class, which manages Google QUIC stream IDs, including stream allocation, activation, and closure handling.

classes.name: LegacyQuicStreamIdManager
classes.description: Manages Google QUIC stream IDs, handling stream allocation, activation, and closure, with support for peer-initiated streams and stream limits.

methods.name: CanOpenNextOutgoingStream
methods.description: Checks if the next outgoing stream ID can be allocated.

methods.name: CanOpenIncomingStream
methods.description: Checks if a new incoming stream can be opened.

methods.name: MaybeIncreaseLargestPeerStreamId
methods.description: Attempts to increase the largest peer stream ID, returns false if it would violate limits.

methods.name: IsAvailableStream
methods.description: Checks if a specific stream ID is available.

methods.name: GetNextOutgoingStreamId
methods.description: Returns the next outgoing stream ID and increments the counter.

methods.name: ActivateStream
methods.description: Marks a stream as active when opened.

methods.name: IsIncomingStream
methods.description: Determines if a stream ID was peer-initiated.

methods.name: MaxAvailableStreams
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of available streams.

methods.name: set_max_open_incoming_streams
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of incoming streams.

methods.name: set_max_open_outgoing_streams
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of outgoing streams.

methods.name: set_largest_peer_created_stream_id
methods.description: Sets the largest peer-created stream ID.

methods.name: max_open_incoming_streams
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of incoming streams.

methods.name: max_open_outgoing_streams
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of outgoing streams.

methods.name: next_outgoing_stream_id
methods.description: Returns the next outgoing stream ID.

methods.name: largest_peer_created_stream_id
methods.description: Returns the largest peer-created stream ID.

methods.name: GetNumAvailableStreams
methods.description: Returns the number of available streams.

methods.name: num_open_incoming_streams
methods.description: Returns the count of open incoming streams.

methods.name: num_open_outgoing_streams
methods.description: Returns the count of open outgoing streams.
